title: Homework, lesson 60: Complete the charge and energy question set on the portal.
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Seeded from gcse-science/y10 lesson 60 (Complete the charge and energy question set on the portal.)
intro: Lesson 60: Current as a flow of charge, and potential difference. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: A 9.0 V battery transfers 54 J of energy. How much charge has passed?
questions.a: A) 6.0 C. Q = E ÷ V = 54 ÷ 9.0 = 6.0 C. 486 comes from multiplying instead of dividing.

questions.q: Current in metals is a flow of...

questions.a: A material that lets charge flow.

questions.q: Q = I × t. Q is measured in...
Big question: what actually moves in a wire when a lamp lights?
questions.a: Free electrons drift through the metal; they transfer energy from the supply to the lamp.

questions.q: A current of 0.5 A flows for 2 minutes. Charge?
questions.model: Formula: Q = I × t. Convert: 2 minutes = 120 s. Substitute: 0.5 × 120 = 60. Q = 60 C.

questions.q: 12 C pass through a lamp with 6 V across it. Energy transferred?

questions.a: 1 joule of energy per coulomb of charge.

questions.q: Six Q = It and E = QV questions (portal worksheet).
questions.a: Answers in the key, e.g. 2 A for 30 s = 60 C; 60 C at 9 V = 540 J.
questions.model: Teacher does question 1: 2 A for 30 s: Q = 2 × 30 = 60 C.

questions.q: A phone battery supplies 3.7 V and passes 5000 C. Energy transferred?
Explain why the current is the same before and after a lamp in series.
questions.a: Charge is conserved; electrons are not used up (1); the same number pass each point per second (1).
